metadata.title: T Mohammed Arif | Full Stack Developer
metadata.description: Part-Time Full Stack Developer specializing in Next.js, Node.js, and Automation. Building real-world web systems and institutional platforms in Salem, Tamilnadu.

about.bio: I engineer digital experiences that blur the line between art and technology — crafting fast, beautiful, soul-first products for the real world.

experience.role: Part-Time Full Stack Developer & Automation Support
experience.summary: Working as a part-time developer supporting hospital web systems, automation, and internal tools. Handled end-to-end development, API routes, database tuning, Zoho Creator configuration, and workflow automation to simplify operations.

impacts.headline: Infrastructure at Scale
impacts.body: Owned and maintained critical hospital software and hardware stacks — ensuring zero-downtime 24/7 across a live medical facility.

impacts.headline: Zero Downtime Resolution
impacts.body: First-response technical support for medical staff. Diagnosed and resolved high-priority system failures before they impacted patient care.

impacts.headline: Query & DB Optimization
impacts.body: Tuned SQL and MongoDB queries, restructured data pipelines and cut administrative retrieval times significantly.

impacts.headline: Automation Engineering
impacts.body: Built streamlined Zoho Creator and custom workflows eliminating manual data entry and reducing human error across departments.

impacts.headline: Campaign Design
impacts.body: Designed digital campaigns and medical information visuals — bridging clinical complexity with clear, impactful communication.

projects.title: AVSEC
projects.label: College Website
projects.description: Official website of AVS Engineering College — high-performance, Tamil Nadu's flagship institution.
projects.longDescription: Designed and developed the official website of AVS Engineering College, Salem. Managed frontend design, backend logic, and responsive UI optimizations to handle heavy loads of prospective students and administrative updates. Actively used by students, staff, and visitors.

projects.title: SSWC
projects.label: College Website
projects.description: Mobile-first site for Sakthi Kailash Women's College — admissions, departments, campus life.
projects.longDescription: Designed and built Sakthi Kailash Women's College portal. Focused heavily on mobile usability, SEO optimizations, and speed benchmarks to guarantee excellent accessibility for all target metrics.

projects.title: AVS OMALUR
projects.label: College Portal
projects.description: Production-ready academic portal — programmes, events, SEO-optimized for students & faculty.
projects.longDescription: Created the primary online presence for Sakthi Kailash Arts and Science College / AVS College Omalur. Streamlined academic navigation, department information layouts, and integrated simple forms for query submissions.

projects.title: CINEMAHUB
projects.label: Booking Platform
projects.description: Live ticket booking with interactive seat selection and automated email confirmations.
projects.longDescription: A complete, modern movie ticket booking application mimicking cinema architectures. Implements dynamic seat status grids, interactive cart states, authentication structures, and transactional confirmations.

projects.title: PIX2PLATE
projects.label: AI Vision
projects.description: Deep learning platform for food recognition and nutritional analysis via computer vision.
projects.longDescription: An innovative AI-powered food tracking web tool. Combines computer vision models to identify dishes from uploaded food imagery, fetching detailed nutritional metadata and tracking historical logs for users.

projects.title: MOVIE AI
projects.label: ML Recommender
projects.description: Cosine-similarity recommendation engine over a rich curated movie dataset.
projects.longDescription: An interactive machine learning movie recommendation system using content-based filtering algorithms. Recommends cinema titles based on title descriptions, cast, and keyword associations.
